data_description.discovery_prefix: Only change this if you use a custom Tasmota binary that does not use the default `tasmota/discovery` discovery topic prefix

confirm.description: Do you want to set up Tasmota?

camera_image_error.message: An error occurred while getting a new camera image from {entity_id}

download_check_failed.message: Could not check the firmware image {url}: {error}

firmware_changed.message: The firmware of the device changed while the update was being prepared.

firmware_not_available.message: The firmware image {url} is not available (HTTP status {status}).

install_in_progress.message: A firmware update of this device is already running.

install_interrupted.message: The firmware update was interrupted because the Tasmota integration was unloaded.

install_not_supported.message: Firmware {version} can't be updated from Home Assistant. Only official Tasmota release builds from version 14.0.0 can be updated.

install_timeout.message: The device did not report a new firmware version within {minutes} minutes.

no_response.message: The device did not answer the OtaUrl command.

same_version.message: The device restarted, but still runs firmware version {version}.

topic_changed.message: The device announced a new MQTT topic, which Home Assistant did not accept. Fix the topic of the device first.

topic_duplicated.message: Several Tasmota devices share the topic {topic}. A firmware update would be sent to all of them.

topic_group.message: The MQTT topic {topic} of the device is also the default group topic of Tasmota. A firmware update would be sent to all devices of the group.

topic_overlap.message: The MQTT topic {topic} of the device starts with the topic {other} of another device, which would receive the firmware update as well.

unexpected_ota_url.message: The device reported {url} as its default OTA URL, which is not the official Tasmota release image for this device.

unexpected_version.message: The device restarted with firmware version {version}, which is older than version {previous} before the update.

upgrade_failed.message: The device reported a failed upgrade: {message}

upgrade_url_mismatch.message: The device downloads the firmware from {url}, which is not the image that was checked.

topic_no_prefix.description:
Tasmota device {name} with IP {ip} does not include `%prefix%` in its FullTopic.
